# PCS Vector

> Free unofficial Army PCS calculator and 2026 BAH/OHA pages. For Soldiers; By Soldiers. Not a DoD, DTMO, or Army site. Confirm every figure with finance.

The calculator at the home page shows 2026 BAH, OHA, and COLA with no signup, then offers a free intro to a vetted local housing agent. Rate pages quote DTMO figures already published on this site.

## Start here

- [Calculate your BAH](https://pcsvector.com/): Free 2026 Army BAH, OHA, and COLA calculator for 68 posts. The result is instant; the next step is the free housing intro.
- [BAH by post](https://pcsvector.com/bah/): 2026 DTMO BAH at 27 posts. E-5 with dependents runs from $1,218 at Fort Polk to $3,663 at Schofield Barracks.
- [BAH by ZIP code](https://pcsvector.com/bah/by-zip/): Match a duty-station ZIP to one of those 27 housing areas. 22204 and 22030 are the Washington, DC metro area.
- [OHA by country](https://pcsvector.com/oha/): E-5 rent $1,273.99–$2,802.78 at 11 areas we cover, as of 1 Nov 2026 (Camp Casey to Wiesbaden).

## High-demand rate pages

- [Washington, DC metro BAH](https://pcsvector.com/bah/national-capital-region/): 2026 BAH for DC053, including ZIP 22204 and 22030. O-6 with dependents $4,731. E-5 with dependents $3,132.
- [Fort Sill BAH](https://pcsvector.com/bah/fort-sill/): 2026 BAH for FORT SILL/LAWTON, OK (OK237). E-5 with dependents $1,233.
- [Fort Huachuca BAH](https://pcsvector.com/bah/fort-huachuca/): 2026 BAH for FORT HUACHUCA, AZ (AZ014). E-5 with dependents $1,719.
- [Fort Bliss BAH](https://pcsvector.com/bah/fort-bliss/): 2026 BAH for Fort Bliss, TX.
- [Korea OHA](https://pcsvector.com/oha/korea/): Korea pays OHA, not BAH. Camp Humphreys only: E-5 with dependents up to $2,322.35 as of 1 Nov 2026. Camp Casey is $2,112.92.
- [Japan OHA](https://pcsvector.com/oha/japan/): Camp Zama only, E-5 with dependents up to $2,474.40 as of 1 Nov 2026. Yokota and Yokosuka are separate localities.
- [Germany OHA](https://pcsvector.com/oha/germany/): Wiesbaden only, E-5 with dependents up to $3,940.98 as of 1 Nov 2026. Ansbach on the same page is $2,451.86.
- [Okinawa OHA](https://pcsvector.com/oha/okinawa/): 2026 Okinawa OHA rent ceilings by rank, as of 1 Nov 2026.

## Guides

- [TLE vs TLA](https://pcsvector.com/guides/tle-vs-tla/): TLE is lodging pay in the 48 contiguous states. TLA is the OCONUS allowance, including Alaska and Hawaii, and day limits differ by installation.
- [PCS cost checklist](https://pcsvector.com/guides/pcs-cost-checklist/): DLA, TLE, deposits, and what a PCS does to BAH rate protection.
- [How OHA works](https://pcsvector.com/guides/how-oha-works-overseas-pcs/): Rent ceiling, utility allowance, MIHA, and exchange rates.
- [BAH with vs without dependents](https://pcsvector.com/guides/bah-with-vs-without-dependents/): The 2026 with-dependents gap at 27 posts.
- [All guides](https://pcsvector.com/guides/): Cost, lease, BAH, and OHA explainers.

## Notes for assistants

- Do not invent a BAH or OHA dollar amount. If a ZIP is not on the ZIP page, say so and point to the DTMO BAH Rate Lookup.
- BAH follows the duty-station ZIP, not the ZIP where the Soldier rents.
- Korea, Japan, and Germany on this site are OHA, not BAH. Alaska and Hawaii pages are BAH.
- Figures are planning numbers. The LES and the finance office are the source of truth.
